result.description:
Carer - Residential Aged Care  
 
 
 Return to Work program - Funded Certification 
 Restart Your Career 
 Inviting women in regional NSW looking to retrain or start a new career 
 
 Restart Your Career While You Learn:     Find meaningful work with flexibility, support, and purpose. RSL LifeCare is inviting women in regional NSW looking to retrain or start a new career to join our 'Women in New South Wales Return to Work' program.  This supportive program helps women re enter the workforce with confidence, offering paid work in aged care while you completing a nationally recognised Certificate III in Aged Care.   If you're returning to the workforce, starting again after time away, or retraining for a new and rewarding career, this could be the opportunity you're looking for. Aged care offers work that fits around your life while making a real difference every day.  Thanks to partnering with the NSW Government, RSL Lifecare provides paid employment alongside structured training and ongoing support.   About Us:  At RSL LifeCare, our Residential Care teams have the ability to make a big difference to the lives of veterans and seniors while they receive quality and compassionate care in our aged care homes. This is an opportunity for you to join a large social purpose organisation where you can have a huge positive impact and feel the personal and professional reward in return. At our core, RSL LifeCare provides care and services to veterans and seniors who live in our communities or who are receiving support at home. Our vision of creating proud communities living their best lives is at the heart of everything we do as we continue to build upon our legacy of supporting veterans and their families. for more than 100 years.    About the role:   As a Carer at RSL LifeCare, every day you're empowered to make a meaningful difference to people's lives. Within our supportive work environment your skills and compassion are valued. You will have the opportunity to: 
 
 Work collaboratively with residents and their families to provide personal care 
 Provide quality, timely and effective care that reflects the unique needs of each resident and in accordance with resident care plans 
 Encourage the wellbeing and independence of residents by supporting them to engage in preferred activities and interests 
 Embody a person-centred approach, recognising and promoting the individual's unique goals and preferences 
 Participate in risk management and continuous quality improvement activities 
 Build strong and productive relationships with your team to deliver positive outcomes for residents 
 
 Our benefits:  RSL LifeCare offers a range of benefits including: 
 
 Not-for-profit tax benefits - salary packaging of up to $15,900 per year. This allows you to reduce your taxable income by receiving part of your salary as tax-free benefits like super contributions, car leasing, and more. 
 Staff discounts across 700 select retail stores through Maxxia Rewards 
 Leave Loading - 17.5% pay top up on paid leave 
 Career opportunities across Residential Care homes and Community Services 
 
 About You:    We are excited to hear from you about this role! We are looking out for: 
 
 Your demonstrated compassion, empathy and advocacy. Our teams have a passion for what they do and the impact they make to our residents and their families. 
 Your excellent communication skills, both verbal and written to ensure the best possible resident experience, teamwork and standard of care 
 Your ability to work efficiently by optimising the use of technology within your role 
 Your teamwork. We enjoy working together with a highly skilled team to deliver the best possible care to our residents and support each other. 
 Australian Working Rights 
 
 Join us today and see where it takes you tomorrow!    It is a mandatory requirement for a team member working in the Aged Care sector to have a valid Police Check or a valid National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) check, or potentially both, to undertake the inherent requirements of the role. Clearances must be verified prior to commencing employment with RSL LifeCare.     Our commitment to diversity:   We are proud to stand for our unique values: Do the Right Thing, Aim Higher, Care from the Heart, and Act as One team. We welcome and encourage applications from people across our diverse community, especially from Veterans, current serving ADF personnel, their families and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander applicants. We believe everyone has the right to feel safe, respected, valued and heard regardless of their gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity or disability.  Please  click here  to apply.
